name: marketing-feature-grids
title: Feature Grids
description: Product feature and benefit showcase sections for marketing landing pages, displaying icon-plus-copy feature items in grid, list, and simple-grid layouts with a section header.
useWhen: Listing the key features or benefits of a product or service on a landing page below the hero section.
Comparing multiple capabilities in a scannable grid for potential buyers evaluating the product.
Highlighting a set of six to twelve core value propositions with icons and short descriptions.
avoidWhen: More than twelve features need to be shown — group them under categories or use tabbed sections.
Features require detailed explanations longer than two to three sentences — use a dedicated feature sections layout with image.
The content is a comparison between plans or competitors — use a pricing table or comparison table instead.
responsiveBehavior: Feature grids collapse from three or four columns on desktop to two on tablet and one on mobile. List variants display as a single column at all widths.
accessibility: Feature icons are decorative when labels and descriptions are present; set aria-hidden='true' on icon elements.
Section heading that introduces the feature grid must be a semantic heading element (<h2>).
Feature descriptions must have sufficient color contrast against the section background.

variants.title: Grid with content
variants.description: Three-column feature grid with a section heading, feature icon, feature title, and short description per item — the standard feature section for SaaS landing pages.
accessibility: Section heading introduces the grid; feature icons are aria-hidden; feature descriptions have sufficient contrast.

variants.title: Grid with content (Dark)
variants.description: Three-column feature grid adapted for dark marketing surfaces with light text and icons.
accessibility: Feature titles and descriptions must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark section backgrounds.

variants.title: List with content
variants.description: Vertical list feature display with an icon and horizontal text alignment — for features with longer descriptions or when a grid would feel too condensed.
accessibility: List items use semantic list markup; feature icons are aria-hidden; text has sufficient contrast.

variants.title: List with content (Dark)
variants.description: Vertical-list feature section adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: List feature text and icon colors must meet contrast requirements on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Simple grid
variants.description: Minimal feature grid with only a title and short label per item, no icons — for dense feature checklists or capability summaries.
accessibility: Feature titles have sufficient contrast; grid items use semantic list or article elements.

variants.title: Simple grid (Dark)
variants.description: Minimal icon-free feature grid adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: Feature text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark grid section backgrounds.

variants.title: Grid with list items
variants.description: Feature grid where each card contains a bulleted list of sub-features rather than a single description — for grouping related capabilities under a category heading.
accessibility: Sub-feature lists use <ul> elements; list items and category headings must have sufficient contrast.

variants.title: Grid with list items (Dark)
variants.description: Sub-feature list grid adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: Category headings and list item text must meet contrast requirements on dark card backgrounds.
